# Introduction 

This document runs a set of comparative AR models, to compare other routes to identifying changes in predictability through time. 

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(tidyverse)
set.seed(1)
```


## Load Data 

```{R}
FiltDf_Compact <- read_csv('Butterfly Data/FiltDf_Compact.csv')
```

## Load and process PE Fits 


```{R}
read_butterfly_outputs <- function(suffix, model_label) {
  files <- list.files(  "Butterfly_fits",recursive = TRUE,full.names = TRUE)
  expected_name <- paste0(model_label, "_", suffix)
  files <- files[basename(files) == expected_name]
  map_dfr(files, \(file) {
    read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(species = basename(dirname(file)))
  })
}

model_label <- "period_sd_08_O2"
pars     <- read_butterfly_outputs("parameter_summary.csv", model_label)

SpeciesToUse <- unique(pars$species)
```

## Prep AR(2) DATA
```{R}
ar_data <- FiltDf_Compact %>%
  mutate(SPECIES = recode(SPECIES,
                          "Thymelicus lineola/sylvestris"  =   "Thymelicus lineola_sylvestris" )) %>%
  arrange(SPECIES, Site_Name, YEAR)  %>%
  filter( SPECIES %in% SpeciesToUse) %>%
  group_by(SPECIES, Site_Name) %>%
  mutate( z = as.numeric(scale(log1p(SITE_INDEX))),
          lag1 = lag(z, 1),
          lag2 = lag(z, 2),
          abundance_lag1 = lag(SITE_INDEX,1),  #  for checking not all zero
          abundance_lag2 = lag(SITE_INDEX,2),
          consecutive1 = YEAR - lag(YEAR, 1) == 1,
          consecutive2 = YEAR - lag(YEAR, 2) == 2 ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(consecutive1, consecutive2, complete.cases(z, lag1, lag2)) %>% # Require all three observations to be consecutive years
  filter(!(SITE_INDEX == 0 & abundance_lag1 == 0 & abundance_lag2 == 0)) %>% ## remove all zero cases
  mutate(  time_scaled = (YEAR - min(YEAR)) /
             (max(YEAR) - min(YEAR))) 
```

# Function to fit one species

```{r}
fit_ar_species <- function(d,n_draws = 4000) {
  
  terms <- c("lag1","lag2","time_scaled:lag1","time_scaled:lag2")
  
  # Common lag covariance for all models
  lag_cov <- cov(d[,c("lag1","lag2")],use = "complete.obs")
  predicted_variance <- function(phi1,phi2) {
    phi1^2*lag_cov[1,1] + phi2^2*lag_cov[2,2] +
      2*phi1*phi2*lag_cov[1,2]
  }
  
  # Convert coefficient draws to start/end variance-based AR predictability value
  # coefficient uncertainty is propagated by sampling from their estimated MVnorm.
  
  calculate_predictability <- function(b,V,residual_var,model_name) {
    
    draws <- MASS::mvrnorm(n = n_draws,mu = b,Sigma = V)
    
    phi1_start <- draws[,"lag1"]
    phi2_start <- draws[,"lag2"]
    phi1_end <- draws[,"lag1"] + draws[,"time_scaled:lag1"]
    phi2_end <- draws[,"lag2"] + draws[,"time_scaled:lag2"]
    
    pred_start <- predicted_variance(phi1_start,phi2_start)
    pred_end <- predicted_variance(phi1_end,phi2_end)
    
    ar_start <- pred_start/(pred_start + residual_var)
    ar_end <- pred_end/(pred_end + residual_var)
    
    tibble(species = unique(d$SPECIES),model = model_name,draw = seq_len(n_draws),
           ar_start = ar_start,ar_end = ar_end,ar_loss = ar_start-ar_end)
  }
  
  # 1. Pooled AR(2) ---------------------------------------------------------
  fit_pooled <- lm(z ~ time_scaled*(lag1 + lag2),data = d)
  b <- coef(fit_pooled)[terms]
  V <- sandwich::vcovCL(fit_pooled,cluster = ~ Site_Name + YEAR,
                        type = "HC1")[terms,terms]
  dr_pooled <- calculate_predictability(b,V,sigma(fit_pooled)^2,"Pooled")
  
  # 2. Add shared year effects ---------------------------------------------
  fit_year <- lmer(z ~ time_scaled*(lag1 + lag2) +
                     (1 | year_id),data = d,REML = FALSE)
  b <- fixef(fit_year)[terms]
  V <- as.matrix(vcov(fit_year))[terms,terms]
  dr_year <- calculate_predictability(b,V,sigma(fit_year)^2,"Year effect")
  
  # 3. Add site-specific AR effects ----------------------------------------
  fit_site <- lmer(z ~ time_scaled*(lag1 + lag2) +
                     (0 + lag1 | Site_Name) +
                     (0 + lag2 | Site_Name),
                   data = d,REML = FALSE)
  b <- fixef(fit_site)[terms]
  V <- as.matrix(vcov(fit_site))[terms,terms]
  dr_site <- calculate_predictability(b,V,sigma(fit_site)^2,"Site AR effects")
  
  # 4. Full hierarchical model ---------------------------------------------
  fit_full <- lmer(z ~ time_scaled*(lag1 + lag2) +
                     (0 + lag1 | Site_Name) +
                     (0 + lag2 | Site_Name) +
                     (1 | year_id),
                   data = d,REML = FALSE)
  b <- fixef(fit_full)[terms]
  V <- as.matrix(vcov(fit_full))[terms,terms]
  dr_full <- calculate_predictability(b,V,sigma(fit_full)^2,"Full hierarchical")
  
  # Combine draws
  draw_results <- bind_rows(dr_pooled,dr_year,dr_site,dr_full)
  
  # Species summaries
  summary_results <- draw_results %>%
    group_by(species,model) %>%
    summarise(n_obs = nrow(d),n_sites = n_distinct(d$Site_Name),
              ar_start = mean(ar_start),ar_end = mean(ar_end),
              ar_loss_q05 = quantile(ar_loss,0.05),
              ar_loss_q95 = quantile(ar_loss,0.95),
              mean_ar_loss = mean(ar_loss),.groups = "drop") %>%
    rename(ar_loss = mean_ar_loss) %>%
    mutate(singular = case_when(  model == "Pooled" ~ FALSE,
      model == "Year effect" ~ isSingular(fit_year),
      model == "Site AR effects" ~ isSingular(fit_site),
      model == "Full hierarchical" ~ isSingular(fit_full)))
  
  return(list(summary = summary_results,draws = draw_results))
}

```

# Fit Across all species

```{R}
ar_fits <- ar_data %>%
  mutate(year_id = factor(YEAR)) %>%
  group_split(SPECIES) %>%
  map(fit_ar_species)

ar_results <- ar_fits %>%
  map_dfr("summary")

ar_draws <- ar_fits %>%
  map_dfr("draws")

```

# Inspect Results

```{R}
ar_results %>%
  arrange(desc(ar_loss))

# How many species show decreases/increases?
ar_results %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise( n = n(),
             mean_loss = mean(ar_loss),
             median_loss = median(ar_loss),
             
             n_decline = sum(ar_loss > 0),
             n_increase = sum(ar_loss < 0),
             
             n_clear_decline = sum(ar_loss_q05 > 0),
             n_clear_increase = sum(ar_loss_q95 < 0))
```

```{r}
overall_ar_draws <- ar_draws %>%
  group_by(model,draw) %>%
  summarise(ar_start = mean(ar_start),
            ar_end = mean(ar_end),
            ar_loss = mean(ar_loss),.groups = "drop")

overall_ar <- overall_ar_draws %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(ar_start = mean(ar_start),ar_end = mean(ar_end),
            ar_loss_q05 = quantile(ar_loss,0.05),
            ar_loss_q95 = quantile(ar_loss,0.95),
            mean_ar_loss = mean(ar_loss),.groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(ar_loss = mean_ar_loss)

overall_ar

```

# Compare with PE 

```{R}
pe_change <- pars %>%
  filter(variable == "pe_slope") %>%
  transmute(species,pe_change = mean,
            pe_q05 = q5,pe_q95 = q95)

```

```{R}
comparison <- pe_change %>%
  left_join(ar_results,by = "species")

spearmans<- comparison %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(complete.cases(pe_change,ar_loss)),
            rho_vs_PE = cor(pe_change,ar_loss,method = "spearman",
                      use = "complete.obs"),
            p_value = cor.test(pe_change,ar_loss,
                               method = "spearman",
                               exact = FALSE)$p.value )


left_join(overall_ar,spearmans ) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)



```

### Plotting
```{R}
ggplot(comparison,
       aes(x = ar_loss,y = pe_change)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,colour = "grey75") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,colour = "grey75") +
  # PE uncertainty
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pe_q05,ymax = pe_q95),width = 0) +
  # AR uncertainty
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ar_loss_q05,xmax = ar_loss_q95),height = 0) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", colour = "blue", linewidth = 0.6) +
  labs(x = "Loss of AR(2) predictability",
       y = "Change in permutation entropy") +
  theme_classic()+
  facet_wrap(~model)

```
